summary: The marketing team is juggling urgent operational fixes (Outlook login issues) with strategic pushes on SEO for Asia Star and Intelligent China, the China Going-Global report, and the Knowledge website redesign, all while managing event logistics for upcoming engagements.
summaryDetail: This week, the immediate priority is resolving the Outlook login problem across all devices, which is blocking team communications; the team must delete accounts, re-login, and coordinate with JSB for backend access. Meanwhile, the Knowledge website redesign is moving forward: the team has decided to remove the outdated videos panel, integrate videos into topic sections, and adopt a two-menu structure, with Joseph sharing his HTML design for feedback. On the SEO front, Asia Star and Intelligent China remain the focus, with Joseph tasked to create target area drafts and request conversion tracking briefs, while the team analyzes participant data for audience profiles. The China Going-Global report is in its final stages, with Joseph set to send the English report to Professor Li Wei and final copy to Flow by August 12. Additionally, event logistics for the EV event and Eurocham event are being managed, with registration updates and speaker title confirmations due soon. Upcoming, the team will promote the CKGSB Business Conditions Index on social media and continue refining the website design based on feedback.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the proposed knowledge website redesign, noting that while the menu categorization improved, the overall layout remained similar to the current site. They discussed incorporating elements from Joseph's alternative design to display more articles and indices on the homepage.

meetings.title: SEO Strategy and Program Prioritization
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing, with a focus on improving search visibility for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing in China.
